blocks.text: Table 2.2 atom ke teen fundamental (bunyadi) particles, electron, proton aur neutron, ki khoobiyan (properties) dikhata hai.

blocks.caption: Table 2.2 Teen fundamental particles ki properties

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Relative charge mein proton +1, electron −1 aur neutron 0 hai. Proton aur neutron ka mass taqreeban 1 amu hai, jab ke electron ka sirf 5.4858 × 10⁻⁴ amu, yani taqreeban 1/1836. Is liye atom ka taqreeban sara mass nucleus mein hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Table se dikhayein ke atom ka mass taqreeban poora us ke nucleus mein kyun hai.
blocks.explanation: Proton ya neutron ka mass taqreeban 1 amu hai, jab ke electron ka 5.4858 × 10⁻⁴ amu, yani taqreeban 1/1836. Is liye bohat se electrons wala atom bhi apna taqreeban sara mass nucleus ke protons aur neutrons mein rakhta hai.

blocks.prompt: ³⁹₁₉K, ³⁵₁₇Cl aur ⁴⁰₁₈Ar mein neutrons ki tadaad nikalein.
blocks.explanation: N = A − Z. Potassium: 39 − 19 = 20. Chlorine: 35 − 17 = 18. Argon: 40 − 18 = 22.

items: Proton +1, 1.0073 amu; neutron 0, 1.0087 amu; electron −1, 5.4858 × 10⁻⁴ amu.
